A .NET tool that audits a site's cookie consent banner. Drives a real headless browser through the site once per consent decision a visitor can make, and compares what actually gets set against what the cookie policy page declares. Anything set outside the consent it needed is a violation; anything undeclared can be appended to the policy page as a draft for an editor to review. Install with `dotnet tool install -g Esatto.CookieScan.Cli`, then run `esatto-cookiescan --url https://example.com`.
